# Scope decisions — Landing screenshots ship resized variants generated by a Playwright script (issue #3929)

_Recorded 2026-10-16 · issue #3929._

- **Variants are `<file>-<width>.webp` beside the original, generated by `npm run shots:resize` in the repo's Playwright Chromium.** No new image dependency (`sharp` rejected); no source PNGs exist, so it resizes the shipped originals. Desktop 640/1280, phone 416. They stay under `public/screenshots/`, so the PWA precache exclusion still covers them. The zoom keeps the original.
